name: Cursor
summary: AI coding editor and agent. cursor.sh redirects here.
description: Cursor is an AI coding product. Its homepage says agents turn ideas into code. cursor.sh redirected to cursor.com on 21 October 2026. The pricing page the same day listed Free at $0 with limited AI usage, Plus at $8/month, Premium at $30/month, Super at $100/month, Ultra at $200/month, and Teams from $30 per user each month. The page also mentions Grok models and says third-party model usage is billed separately. The old Free-only label is wrong.

features: AI Code Review: Highlights logic flaws and inefficiencies.

IDE-Like Environment: Works in a web-based AI IDE with debugging tools.
